name: Belmont
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Belmont, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Belmont, NC: the tree lighting and Christmas Parade, plus Holidays at the Garden at Daniel Stowe Botanical Garden.
lede: Belmont lights its town tree at Old City Hall, holds a downtown Christmas parade with Santa, and has Holidays at the Garden at Daniel Stowe nearby.
celebrates: The City of Belmont lights its Christmas tree at Old City Hall on Main Street the evening before its Christmas Parade, which marches through historic downtown with floats, vintage cars, area school marching bands and Santa Claus, according to the Gaston County calendar. Go Gaston NC also points visitors to Belmont's Festival of Trees at Stowe Park. Just outside town, the Daniel Stowe Botanical Garden holds Holidays at the Garden, which is carried on our Charlotte page and moves here.
lastyear: Belmont's tree lighting and Christmas Parade have long opened the Gaston County parade season. The Gaston County calendar lists the 2026 tree lighting on Monday, November 30, at Old City Hall and the parade on Tuesday, December 1, at 3 pm, ahead of Mount Holly and Gastonia. Go Gaston NC publishes a county guide to Christmas parades each autumn, with Belmont first on its December list.
facts: Belmont's parade starts at Main and Catawba Streets, according to the Gaston County calendar. Old City Hall, where the town tree is lit, is at 37 N. Main Street. Belmont is one of eleven Gaston County communities on the Go Gaston NC Christmas parade list, and its parade is the first in December, followed by Cramerton on December 3 and Mount Holly on December 5.
trains: Belmont has no museum train of its own on our list. The nearest train ride at Christmas is the Bela Express at the Kings Mountain Christmas Parade and Festival on December 5, which is carried on our Gastonia page. McAdenville's Christmas Town U.S.A. is another Gaston County stop a short drive away, and our Charlotte page lists the Polar Express train ride in Spencer.
traditions: Floats, vintage cars, school bands and Santa in historic downtown.

kidfact: Santa Claus rides in the Belmont Christmas Parade, according to the Gaston County calendar.
faq: When is the Belmont Christmas Parade?
Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 3 pm at Main and Catawba Streets in historic downtown Belmont.
When is the Belmont tree lighting?
Monday, November 30, 2026, at 6 pm at Old City Hall, 37 N. Main Street.
Is Santa in the Belmont parade?
Yes. The Gaston County calendar says Santa Claus appears, along with floats, vintage cars and school marching bands.
What else is in Belmont at Christmas?
Daniel Stowe Botanical Garden hosts Holidays at the Garden, and Go Gaston NC lists a Festival of Trees at Stowe Park.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Belmont for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 30 (Belmont Christmas Tree Lighting and Christmas Parade) through the Holidays at the Garden season at Daniel Stowe Botanical Garden. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Belmont

  • 2 Christmas events for kids in Belmont
  • 1 free event: the tree lighting and Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa rides in the Belmont Christmas Parade on December 1
  • Parades and tree lightings: tree lighting at Old City Hall on November 30 and the parade on December 1
  • Season: November 30, 2026 onward

Planning a bigger day out? Belmont families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Charlotte, which covers Christmas Town U.S.A. in McAdenville, Winterfest at Carowinds, the Nutcracker at Belk Theater and Light the Knights at Truist Field.
